plugin.note: Solo or duo Royal Titans: prioritise melee, carry ranged for distant phases, and use opposing-element spells for barriers and minions. High-end duo resetting can omit the magic switch.

requirements: There are no quest or skill requirements to enter the Royal Titans arena.
The Wiki recommends about 70 combat skills, 43 Prayer and 75 Magic. Wave-spell presets explicitly require 75 Magic and the standard spellbook for reliable 40-damage elemental hits.
Branda counts as a fire giant and Eldric as an ice giant. Slayer assignment bonuses apply only to the matching Titan; neither boss requires a task.
mechanics: The two Titans each have 600 Hitpoints and 100 Defence. Their slight crush weakness does not justify replacing a stronger weapon with a weaker crush weapon.
Ranged accuracy is multiplied by six when Titans are outside melee reach and during elemental blast, including its charge and a few ticks afterwards; prioritise melee while it is available.
The preset uses melee as its primary style and lists required ranged and magic switches explicitly. Static phase guidance does not produce live tile or prayer prompts.

methods.label: Solo melee, ranged and Wave sustain
methods.summary: A supply-focused setup uses a complete magic switch and a shortbow ranged switch to clear minions reliably.
prayers: Protect from Melee during stomps; appropriate offensive prayers for the chosen style
steps: Start with melee while the Titans are adjacent, then switch weapon, ammunition, body, legs and cape for the ranged portion.

Use the full listed magic switch for opposing-element Wave spells on elementals. Twinflame automatically changes fire/water and provides those elemental runes; the supplied air and blood runes cover 500 total Wave casts.
Water spells clear Branda's fire walls and fire elementals; fire spells clear Eldric's ice walls and ice elementals. Return to melee when the boss is reachable.
Before taking a Titan below 210 Hitpoints, manage both health bars so the other is also low. Follow the phase-two blast reference.
notes: The seven magic switch pieces total +93 magic attack before the remaining head, boots, ammunition and ring. The fixed head and Aranea boots keep this above the required +70 threshold.
This authored budget switch uses the Wiki's suggested magic-accuracy approach; individual item bonuses were checked against their current raw infoboxes.

methods.label: Solo full void with helmet switches
methods.summary: The full void set reduces the magic-accuracy threshold to +39 and needs fewer armour switches.
steps: Keep the complete void body, robe and gloves equipped throughout. Use the melee helm with the melee weapon.
Switch to the ranger helm and Eclipse atlatl with atlatl darts for distant Titans.
For magic, equip Void mage helm, Twinflame staff and the imbued cape while retaining fury, Aranea boots and dragon defender. The Wiki's exact combination totals +39 magic attack.
Use opposing Wave spells on minions and barriers; 75 Magic supplies the 40-damage elemental max hit.
risks: Replacing any void set piece removes the reduced accuracy threshold; the fixed fury, boots, defender and magic cape are part of this exact preset.

methods.label: High-level duo with restoration between kills
methods.summary: A high-end duo can omit elemental clearing and restore health, Prayer and special attack between kills.
steps: Use high-end melee with a full ranged switch for distant phases. Both players need sufficient damage to keep time exposed to elementals short.
This route deliberately accepts elemental and wall damage and restores between kills using an ornate rejuvenation pool or the elite Desert diary statuette.
Use Giantsoul amulet to return quickly. Standard-spell clearing remains the alternative when damage output is insufficient.
notes: Arceuus thralls and dragon claws are optional speed extensions with their own spellbook, quest, rune and equipment requirements. They are not silently assumed by this baseline.
risks: Omitting elemental-clearing magic is appropriate only for short high-damage duo kills; longer fights accumulate avoidable damage.

methods.label: Blue moon and ranged-armour sustain alternatives
methods.summary: Hybrid armour can reduce the number of switches in solo or duo sustain trips.
steps: Blue moon armour can meet the magic threshold with fewer changes while retaining melee strength. Confirm the complete equipped magic attack total, including negative glove, amulet, defender and boot bonuses.
Wearing ranged armour through the melee portion is another low-switch approach. Eclipse atlatl uses melee strength for maximum hit and is especially suited to that compromise.
Use the preserved minimal-switch equipment grid to compare full void and Blue moon choices; mixing isolated void pieces does not grant the void threshold.

methods.label: Single-style alternatives
methods.summary: Melee-only or ranged-only kills are possible but materially slower.
steps: Melee-only requires waiting or repositioning when Titans move out of reach; ranged-only sacrifices the stronger melee windows.
Magic mainly clears barriers and minions. It is not presented by the Wiki as a primary boss-damage setup.
The lower-effort gear transition does not remove the need to handle stomps, elementals and elemental blasts.

methods.label: Arena access and travel
methods.summary: Choose a direct amulet route or an approach through the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon.
steps: Giantsoul amulet teleports directly outside the boss room.
Without it, enter the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon, run north past pirates and muggers, then west; the shortcut immediately west of the ladder requires 60 Agility.
Fairy ring AIQ is south of the entrance. Rat Pits teleport, Port Sarim spirit tree, Explorer's ring and Rimmington house portal are alternative approaches with their own access conditions.

methods.label: Walls, opposing elements and accuracy
methods.summary: Barriers and minions have distinct accuracy and spell rules.
steps: Walls form after four ticks. Standing on a forming tile takes up to 12 damage and prevents that obstacle from appearing.

Water Blast or stronger and ice spells extinguish fire; Fire Blast or stronger melts ice. A successful targeted removal also clears the two adjacent obstacles and does not incur an attack delay, regardless of magic attack bonus.
Each Titan summons three elementals. They melee and eventually explode for 8-10 damage in a 3-by-3 area. Opposing fire/water spells deal area damage and receive their doubled elemental weakness.
At +70 magic attack, or +39 with full void mage, elemental hits are guaranteed maximum damage. Each elemental killed reduces the current attack delay by one tick.
Luring an elemental onto an emerging wall of the opposing element can kill it, but random wall placement makes this unreliable as the main plan.

methods.label: Phase one: melee and ranged windows
methods.summary: The opening and each retreat offer different weapon windows.
steps: The opening allows one or two melee hits before the Titans move away. A four-tick weapon can hit each Titan once; a halberd can obtain two hits on one.
Use ranged during their retreat; after roughly twenty seconds they return to melee and use stomps covering the nearest three rows for up to 26.
Elementals begin after one Titan has taken 100 damage. Deal with the accumulating waves when using the standard-spell plan.
Solo players can stagger the return to melee by staying far from a Titan so it walks farther. This can leave one Titan reachable while the other retreats.
Taking either Titan to 210 Hitpoints or below transitions both into phase two; aim to lower both before triggering it.

methods.label: Phase two: elemental blasts
methods.summary: The final phase expands stomp coverage and limits safe blast positioning.
steps: Both Titans enter the platform at the transition and can knock players for 15-30 damage. Stomps cover the full arena during this phase.
An elemental blast strikes the arena three times with one safe tile. Stomps are generally synchronised until one Titan falls below 100 Hitpoints.
Leaving one Titan healthy makes the finish harder: its stomp can hit 10 through prayer and the blast safe tile is on the farthest row.
Between blast strikes there is one safe tick for a melee hit only when the safe tile is two tiles from that Titan; a halberd can reach from three. Otherwise use ranged.
Subduing a Titan during the blast charge removes that Titan's covered area for that cast. This is a static timing reference rather than a live prompt.

methods.label: Sustain inventories and restoration routes
methods.summary: Switch count and restoration access determine trip length.
steps: Budget and mid-game sustain use melee, ranged and accurate magic gear, prayer restoration, combat boosts, Wave runes and an emergency teleport.
Twinflame supplies infinite fire and water runes, leaving air and blood for Wave spells; other staves require the missing elemental runes.
Late-game standard-spell setups can carry Noxious halberd for the central blast reach option. Full ranged and magic switches leave fewer food slots.

The resetting duo route uses Giantsoul and a return teleport to an ornate pool or the elite Desert diary statuette. Thralls are an optional Arceuus extension, not compatible with a simultaneously selected standard spellbook.

methods.label: Fire and ice giant task choices
methods.summary: Only the matching Titan receives assignment benefits.
steps: Branda counts for fire giants and Eldric for ice giants. An imbued Slayer helmet boosts damage only against the assigned type.
Vannaka is the master listed by the Wiki that assigns both types. Chaeldar, Nieve and Duradel offer fire giants without the ice-giant possibility.
A task-focused blocklist is an optional assignment strategy; the boss can also be fought off-task.
